map_event.title: UNOSAT Gaza Strip Comprehensive Damage Assessment - 15 October 2023
map_event.description: The UNOSAT map illustrates a satellite-imagery based comprehensive damage assessment to detected damage and destruction to structures within the area of interest in the Gaza Strip, Occupied Palestinian Territory, based on an image collected on 15 October 2023 when compared to images collected on 1 May 2023, 10 May 2023, and 18 September 2023. According to satellite imagery analysis, UNOSAT identified 2,017 destroyed structures, 2,282 severely damaged structures and 6,285 moderately damaged structures, for a total of 10,584 structures. This corresponds to around 4% of the total structures in the Gaza Strip. The most affected area appears to be the Beit Hanoun Municipality (inset 1), which represents also the area with the highest number of damaged structures per square kilometer (followed by Jabalya Camp and Jabalya). Among the affected structures, UNOSAT identified 5 schools. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field.
